limitations: Rolling trace tails only; actual window and sample count included for every mode.
Primary/secondary body spans are separate effect calls; frame cadence includes both primary and fixed secondary mode 18.
Scope tracing adds overhead; before/final timing difference includes added instrumentation. No uninstrumented production timing claim.
Section shares are exclusive matched per-call sums / matched full-body sums, never sums of maxima.
Before-stock has no exact frame-start counter; its cadence is unverified.
Lite is a design treatment, not a byte-identical optimisation; visual and byte-difference assessment owned by Stream V.
selection_rule: River modes selected from first lite before repeated capture; Forge selected by root after target and visual checks. All alternatives retained.
